title: Among customers who used EUR currency, how many made transactions at Czech
question: Among customers who used EUR currency, how many made transactions at Czech gas stations during morning hours (before 13:00) on any date in 2012, and whose total annual consumption in 2012 was below 50,000?

prediction.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (
  SELECT c."XCL_001"
  FROM customers AS c
  JOIN transactions_1k AS t ON c."XCL_001" = t."XCL_013"
  JOIN gasstations AS g ON t."XCL_015" = g."XCL_004"
  JOIN yearmonth AS ym ON c."XCL_001" = ym."XCL_019"
  WHERE c."XCL_003" = 'EUR'
    AND g."XCL_006" = 'CZE'
    AND t."XCL_012" < '13:00:00'
    AND t."XCL_011" LIKE '2012%'
    AND SUBSTR(ym."XCL_020", 1, 4) = '2012'
  GROUP BY c."XCL_001"
  HAVING SUM(ym."XCL_021") < 50000
) AS qualifying_customers

  SELECT c."XCL_001"
  FROM customers AS c
  JOIN transactions_1k AS t ON c."XCL_001" = t."XCL_013"
  JOIN gasstations AS g ON t."XCL_015" = g."XCL_004"
  JOIN yearmonth AS ym ON c."XCL_001" = ym."XCL_019"
  WHERE c."XCL_003" = 'EUR'
    AND g."XCL_006" = 'CZE'
    AND t."XCL_012" < '13:00:00'
    AND t."XCL_011" LIKE '2012%'
    AND SUBSTR(ym."XCL_020", 1, 4) = '2012'
  GROUP BY c."XCL_001"
  HAVING SUM(ym."XCL_021") < 50000
) AS qualifying_customers
